All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations / missing (9 — redlined):**
- **LOL-CAP** (critical): Section 7 excludes indirect damages but has **no cap at all**. Added mutual cap (greater of 12 months' fees / USD 1M) with Excluded Claims outside the cap.
- **T4C** (high): No Customer convenience exit during the Initial Term or renewals (only a mutual 90-day post-term right). Added 30-day Customer convenience termination with pro-rata refund; limited Kubient to term-end.
- **RENEWAL**: Auto-renews annually with no non-renewal window; added a 30-day non-renewal notice right.
- **GOVLAW**: Delaware law + exclusive NY courts is acceptable, but Section 8 mandates AAA arbitration in conflict with Section 14(a); removed the arbitration mandate.
- **IP** (critical): Ownership of Customer Data, Requests, Content and deliverables is unaddressed while Kubient stores our data; added ownership, licence-back and no-joint-ownership language.
- **LICENSE** (high): Grant is **revocable**, non-transferable and excludes affiliates/contractors; fixed all three.
- **WARRANTY**: Strong Kubient warranties but no remedy; added re-performance/repair/refund.
- **INSURANCE**: No insurance clause for a data-processing host; inserted CGL/E&O/cyber paragraph.
- **TRANSITION**: Termination allows destruction of our data with no export or migration help; inserted transition-assistance and certified-deletion paragraph.

**Compliant (9):** INDEMN (broad Kubient defence/indemnity covering IP via the Section 9(b)(i) warranty), NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY (expressly non-exclusive), MFN, NOSOLICIT, ASSIGN (affiliate/successor carve-out, no change-of-control trigger), AUDIT, LD, MINCOMMIT — noting that Exhibits, when issued, should be re-checked for volume commitments and fees.
